sp-button sp-button Since: UXP v4.1 Renders a button. See : https://spectrum.adobe.com/page/button/ https://opensource.adobe.com/spectrum-web-components/components/button Example Vectorize Variants There are several variations that are supported. Call to action Renders a "call to action"-style button. This is the default variant if no variant is provided. Click me Primary Renders a "primary" button. Click me Secondary Renders a "secondary" button. Click me Warning Renders a button intended to be used to indicate negative consequences to the action, such as an action that can't be undone. data-variant=warning data-slots=text Spectrum Web Components now uses a negative variant. This will be addressed in a future update. Click me Over Background Renders a button that's suitable over a background (such as an image). Over an Image Disabled Disabled Quiet Quiet buttons do not have a border, and are less visually distracting. data-variant=warning data-slots=text Quiet buttons do not support the cta variant. A quiet button With icon Built-in SVG icon Zoom Custom SVG icon Edit Text Responding to events You can respond to a click on the button using the click event. document.querySelector(".yourButton").addEventListener("click", evt => { console.log("Button clicked"); })
